name: OPW waterlevel.ie (Ireland real-time river, lake and tidal levels)
short: Ireland's Office of Public Works gauges: about 2,000 level sensors as one GeoJSON, CSV history. CC BY 4.0, no key.
summary: The Office of Public Works (OPW) runs the Irish hydrometric network and publishes real-time readings at waterlevel.ie, with pre-generated files meant for automated use. On 2026-11-07 UTC the latest-readings GeoJSON at /geojson/latest/ answered 200 with 2,032 features, the newest stamped 18:30:00Z. Each feature has station reference, name, sensor, region, UTC datetime, value (for example Sandy Mills, station 0000001041, sensor 0001, 0.346) and an error code, with coordinates. Per-station CSV files for day, week and month (35 days) are served at /data/<period>/<station>_<sensor>.csv. Sensor 0001 is water level, 0002 temperature, OD level to Ordnance Datum. The site says data refresh about every 5 minutes with new station data about every 15.

tasks: latest water level at Irish river, lake and tidal gauges (all stations in one GeoJSON)

coverage.notes: OPW says about 380 hydrometric stations exist and not all are shown; the latest-readings file listed 2,032 station-sensor readings. Rivers, lakes and tidal sites. Only stations with reference numbers 00001 to 41000 may be republished; others need OPW permission.

rate_limit.notes: Stated: do not bulk-download more often than once every 15 minutes; OPW may block users who put undue load on the servers.

delivery.basis: Live GET 2026-11-07 UTC: /geojson/latest/ newest datetime 18:30:00Z. Page says site data update about every 5 minutes and station data arrive about every 15 minutes.

latency.notes: Some observations arrive later because of clock differences and mobile network latency, per the provider.

freshness.notes: One sample only. Some stations in the file are older than others.

licensing.summary: Reusable under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International. Derived works must reference waterlevel.ie and the site disclaimer; suggested text: Contains Irish Public Sector Information licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) licence (source waterlevel.ie, provided by the Office of Public Works). OPW asks (as a courtesy) to be told the IP address and URL of automated clients (waterlevel@opw.ie). Only stations numbered 00001 to 41000 are cleared for republication. Data are provisional readings, subject to the site disclaimer.

time.method: Each reading has a UTC datetime.
time.unknown: Telemetry delay is not stated per reading.

content.method: OPW instrument readings with an error code field (value 99 in the sample).
content.unknown: Meaning of err_code values was not checked; readings are unvalidated real-time values per the disclaimer.

human.unknown: Not applicable: automated instruments, not people.

application.unknown: No signing or attestation from instrument to API is documented.

camera.unknown: Not applicable: no camera frames in this feed.

corroboration.unknown: Nothing documented independently confirms individual readings.

auth.how_to_get: No key sent or needed in the calls made.

endpoints.notes: Call made. All latest readings with coordinates.

api.rate_limits: No bulk download more often than every 15 minutes.
api.notes: Use only the pre-generated files, not the dynamic pages, for automation.
